question: After years of working in a noisy environment, he has become ________ to the constant sounds of machinery around him.
explanation: indifferent: thờ ơ; sensitive: nhạy cảm; averse: không thích; accustomed: quen với. Cấu trúc 'become accustomed to sth' có nghĩa là quen với điều gì đó sau thời gian dài.

question: People from generation Z ____________ use apps in creative ways since they've been acquainted with such apps from a young age.
explanation: have to: phải; can: có thể (khả năng hiện tại); could: có thể (khả năng quá khứ); would: sẽ/giả định. Ngữ cảnh diễn tả khả năng hiện tại của thế hệ Z nên dùng 'can'.

question: I can't stand __________all the time when I'm trying to focus on important tasks.
explanation: Cấu trúc 'can't stand + V-ing' (không thể chịu được việc gì). Dùng thể bị động 'being interrupted' vì chủ ngữ là đối tượng bị ngắt quãng.

question: The heavy fog in the mountains resulted in low ______, making it difficult for drivers to see the road ahead.
explanation: vision: khả năng nhìn chung; view: cảnh nhìn; visibility: tầm nhìn (trong điều kiện môi trường); sight: thị lực. 'Low visibility' là cụm từ cố định chỉ tầm nhìn bị hạn chế do sương mù.

question: Have you got something _____________I can eat before our dinner?
explanation: Sau đại từ bất định 'something' dùng đại từ quan hệ 'that' để chỉ vật.

question: The Prime Minister is to consider changes to sexually ____________ laws to enforce equal opportunities.
explanation: discriminate (v); discrimination (n); discriminatory (adj: có tính phân biệt); discriminated (VpII). Vị trí đứng trước danh từ 'laws' cần tính từ.

question: He would have repaired the car himself if he _______________ the tools.
explanation: Câu điều kiện loại 3 diễn tả điều không có thật ở quá khứ: If + S + had + VpII, S + would have + VpII. 'Had had' là dạng quá khứ phân từ của động từ 'have'.

question: I was feeling nervous when I gave my presentation because I ______ for weeks.
explanation: Thì quá khứ hoàn thành tiếp diễn 'had been doing' diễn tả hành động kéo dài liên tục trong một khoảng thời gian trước một sự kiện khác trong quá khứ.

question: During the meeting, she didn’t hesitate to _______ the conversation to share her thoughts.
explanation: cut out for: phù hợp; call in for: yêu cầu; make off with: lấy trộm; break in on: cắt ngang cuộc nói chuyện.

question: ___________ talented musician has been recognized for their contributions to modern jazz.
explanation: 'Many a + danh từ số ít' có nghĩa là 'rất nhiều' và đi với động từ số ít. Các phương án khác đều dùng cho danh từ số nhiều hoặc không đếm được.

question: The scientist’s discovery of a new species in the remote jungle was so incredible that it sparked worldwide interest. (Tìm từ đồng nghĩa với từ được gạch chân)
explanation: incredible = unbelievable: không thể tin được.

question: The court has just enacted a ruling to protect historical monuments from being demolished for construction. (Tìm từ đồng nghĩa với từ được gạch chân)
explanation: enacted trong ngữ cảnh này có nghĩa là ban hành/thực thi, đồng nghĩa với 'upheld'.

question: Hardly had the coach announced the new rule of unauthorizing substitutions when the team made a change. (Tìm từ trái nghĩa với từ được gạch chân)
explanation: unauthorizing: không cho phép, trái nghĩa với 'permitting': cho phép.

question: After months of dedicated effort, the improvement in their performance became noticeable to all observers. (Tìm từ trái nghĩa với từ được gạch chân)
explanation: noticeable: dễ nhận thấy, trái nghĩa với 'barely perceptible': hầu như không nhận thấy được.

question: Lily: What did you think of the museum? James: ______
options: Incredible! I loved exploring the art collections.
It was just alright, I guess.
explanation: Câu trả lời thể hiện phản ứng rõ ràng, tích cực và phù hợp nhất với câu hỏi về cảm nhận.

question: Sara: I don’t think I can join you for the movie tonight. Jake: ______
options: I didn’t want you to come anyway.
explanation: Câu trả lời thể hiện sự thông cảm, lịch sự và không gây áp lực cho người đối diện.

question: Jake: The weather’s been terrible all week. Lily: ______
options: I know, it’s been a real pain in the neck.
Just take it easy. Weather isn’t a matter.
Terrible. I'm under the weather now.
explanation: Câu trả lời thể hiện sự đồng cảm và chia sẻ cảm nhận chung về tình huống.

question: Chris: I'm really strapped for cash right now. I need to borrow some money to pay for this emergency. David: __________
options: I'm really sorry, but I'm broke too.
Why don't you tighten your belt and cut back on expenses?
I could lend you some money, but you'll have to pay it back later.
Maybe you should consider selling some of your belongings.
explanation: Câu trả lời thể hiện sự sẵn lòng giúp đỡ một cách hợp lý, phù hợp với ngữ cảnh.

question: Sắp xếp các câu cho hội thoại hoàn chỉnh: a. I’d suggest considering Harvard University; their programs are highly respected. b. If you’re looking for something more affordable, Boston University offers great financial aid options. c. Do you have any advice on choosing a good university? d. I’m aiming for a university with a strong academic reputation but is also within my budget.
explanation: Trình tự logic: hỏi lời khuyên → nhận gợi ý → nêu yêu cầu cụ thể → nhận gợi ý phù hợp với yêu cầu.

question: Sắp xếp các câu cho hội thoại hoàn chỉnh: a. Why not cook more at home? It's a healthier and more affordable option. b. That's a great start! You could also try meal prepping to reduce fast food intake. c. I’ve been eating a lot of fast food lately, and I feel like it’s affecting my health. d. I’ve begun preparing easy meals, such as salads and grilled chicken.
explanation: Trình tự logic: nêu vấn đề → nhận lời khuyên → nêu hành động đã thực hiện → nhận lời khuyên tiếp theo.

question: Sắp xếp các câu cho hội thoại hoàn chỉnh: a. Maybe you should call a friend to pick you up next time. b. I’d just present exactly the incident, but I feel like it sounded nonsense. c. What would you say when they asked why you’re late? d. I’m so frustrated that I got on the wrong bus! e. I would say yes. At that moment I came in, everyone had already been there. f. Didn’t this make you miss the meeting yesterday?
explanation: Trình tự logic: nêu sự cố → hỏi về hậu quả → trả lời → hỏi về cách giải thích → nêu băn khoăn → đưa ra lời khuyên.

question: Sắp xếp các câu cho hội thoại hoàn chỉnh: a. I’m thinking about trying vegetarianism, but I’m not sure where to start or what nutrients I’ll need to focus on. b. That sounds like a great approach! It’s a manageable way to ease into a vegetarian diet without feeling overwhelmed. c. I believe that eating vegetarian can have a positive impact on both health and the environment. d. Although vegetarian diets have many benefits, it’s essential to ensure you’re getting a balanced intake of vitamins and protein. e. Are you finding it difficult to adjust to meals without meat? f. You can try a few plant-based meals each week which make the transition to this diet easier.
explanation: Trình tự logic: nêu quan điểm chung → nêu ý định và băn khoăn → nhận lưu ý về dinh dưỡng → hỏi về khó khăn → nhận lời khuyên thực hiện → nhận sự khuyến khích.

question: There was an increased demand for travel, so the government decided to invest in building the very first metro system. (Tìm câu có nghĩa gần nhất)
options: The government opted not to invest in the metro system, even though travel demand was rising.
The government decided to invest in building the metro system, as travel demand was a temporary issue at the time.
That travel high demand led to the government’s decision to build a metro system to address future needs.
Due to the growing demand for travel, the government chose to fund the creation of the first metro system.
explanation: Câu gốc: Nhu cầu đi lại tăng cao nên chính phủ đầu tư xây dựng tàu điện ngầm đầu tiên. Đáp án D giữ nguyên đầy đủ ý nghĩa và mức độ chắc chắn của câu gốc.

question: While both dogs are intelligent, the golden retriever is more playful than the poodle. (Tìm câu có nghĩa gần nhất)
options: The golden retriever is the most playful, although poodles are also intelligent.
The golden retriever and the poodle are equally intelligent, but the golden retriever is more playful.
Most dogs are more intelligent than the golden retriever, but the poodle is the most playful.
The golden retriever is more intelligent than the poodle, but the poodle is more playful.
explanation: Câu gốc: Cả hai đều thông minh, nhưng golden retriever vui tươi hơn. Đáp án B diễn đạt chính xác mối so sánh.

question: Paris is known for its romantic ambiance, whereas New York City is renowned for its bustling energy. (Tìm câu có nghĩa gần nhất)
options: New York City is recognized for its vibrant energy, unlike Paris, which is famous for its romantic vibe.
In terms of ambiance, Paris and New York City are famous for their energy vibe.
The romantic ambiance of Paris matches with the bustling energy of New York City.
New York City is known for its romantic atmosphere, while Paris is recognized for its energetic vibe.
explanation: Câu gốc: Paris lãng mạn, New York năng động. Đáp án A diễn đạt đúng sự tương phản.

question: Only by working diligently and consistently can one achieve true success. (Tìm câu có nghĩa gần nhất)
options: Only diligent and consistent people are able to attain true success.
True success can be reached only when one diligently works toward his consistent goals.
True success is only achievable when one knows how to combine diligence and consistency.
To achieve true success, one must work with consistent and diligent efforts.
explanation: Câu gốc: Chỉ bằng nỗ lực chăm chỉ và nhất quán mới đạt thành công thực sự. Đáp án D diễn đạt đầy đủ và chính xác mục đích và yêu cầu.

question: TikTok challenges all the brands. Many have adapted to reach a global audience because investing in the platform is worthwhile. (Tìm câu có nghĩa gần nhất)
options: TikTok challenges all the brands, but many have adapted to reach a global audience, making it a worthwhile investment.
TikTok challenges the global audience by adapting to the brands, which makes it a worthwhile investment.
TikTok challenges all the brands to invest in it since it is worthless to adapt to reach a global audience.
All the brands find it challenging to invest in Tiktok to reach a global audience, although investing in the platform is worthwhile.
explanation: Câu gốc: TikTok tạo thách thức nhưng nhiều thương hiệu thích nghi vì đầu tư là xứng đáng. Đáp án A giữ nguyên mối quan hệ logic.

question: The team worked long hours to finish the project. Despite this, the final outcome fell short of the original vision. (Tìm câu có nghĩa gần nhất)
options: Despite working long hours to finish the project, the team was able to achieve the original vision.
The team worked long hours to finish the project, but the final outcome failed to align with the original vision.
The final outcome met the original vision, even though the team worked long hours to finish the project.
The team worked long hours to finish the project, which exceeded the original vision.
explanation: Câu gốc: Làm việc chăm chỉ nhưng kết quả không đạt mục tiêu ban đầu. Đáp án B diễn đạt chính xác.

question: The traffic is heavy this morning. There will be delays on the highway. (Tìm câu có nghĩa gần nhất)
options: The highways are definitely able to be delayed due to the heavy traffic this morning.
Since the traffic is heavy this morning, delays on the highway are not expected.
Delays on the highway are probably a given on account of the heavy traffic this morning.
The heavy traffic this morning could make delays on the highway become true.
explanation: Câu gốc: Giao thông đông → chắc chắn sẽ có chậm trễ. Đáp án C dùng 'probably a given' diễn đạt mức độ chắc chắn hợp lý nhất.

question: She weighed studying abroad against continuing in her home country. In the end, she chose to study abroad. (Tìm câu có nghĩa gần nhất)
options: She considered studying abroad but would prefer to stay in her home country.
Among options, she would rather study abroad than continue studying in her home country.
She decided to study abroad without considering other possibilities.
She studied abroad because continuing in her home country was not an option.
explanation: Câu gốc: Cân nhắc hai lựa chọn và chọn du học. Đáp án B diễn đạt chính xác sự so sánh và lựa chọn cuối cùng.

question: Điền vào chỗ trống: ___________ is a selection of stimulating toys, books and other activities.
explanation: Cần một mệnh đề danh từ làm chủ ngữ. Cấu trúc 'What + S + V' có nghĩa là 'điều mà họ nên làm/cung cấp'.

question: Điền vào chỗ trống: Nowadays there is plenty of good material available for young children, and of course, ______________ will also encourage them to read.
options: seeing plenty of books in use about the house
plenty of books in use about the house are seen
the house in use about plenty of books which is seen
which can see plenty of books in use about the house
explanation: Danh động từ 'seeing...' làm chủ ngữ của mệnh đề phụ, diễn tả hành động nhìn thấy sách khắp nhà sẽ khuyến khích trẻ đọc sách.

question: Điền vào chỗ trống: ...and are ______________ valuable in helping to increase vocabulary and concentration.
explanation: 'equally valuable' có nghĩa là có giá trị như nhau, chỉ cả sách và video đều hữu ích như nhau cho việc học của trẻ.

question: Điền vào chỗ trống: ...mainly because too many spend too much time watching programmes not ____________ for their age group.
explanation: Cấu trúc rút gọn mệnh đề quan hệ bị động: 'programmes which are not intended for' → 'programmes not intended for' (chương trình không dành cho đối tượng nào).

question: Điền vào chỗ trống: ...so children will pounce on books which ____________ their favourite television characters...
explanation: 'feature' có nghĩa là có nhân vật/đặc điểm nổi bật nào đó, phù hợp với ngữ cảnh sách có các nhân vật phim truyền hình yêu thích.

question: Why do facial wrinkles appear?
options: Repetitive muscle movements and thin skin textures
Aging process and poor blood circulation in facial muscles
Lack of daily moisturizing with wrong skincare routines
explanation: Theo bài viết, nếp nhăn xuất hiện do hai nguyên nhân: cơ bắp chuyển động lặp đi lặp lại và lớp da hạ bì mỏng đi.

question: What is the main idea of the third paragraph?
options: Botox reduces wrinkles but doesn’t stop all aging.
Botox permanently prevents skin thinning and wrinkles.
Botox eliminates the need for other anti-aging treatments.
Botox only works on unwrinkled skin, not aged skin.
explanation: Đoạn 3 nêu Botox tác động đến nguyên nhân cơ bắp nhưng không ngăn được da mỏng đi, không phải là giải pháp hoàn hảo.

question: What does the word “them” in the third paragraph refer to?
explanation: Câu trước đó nói về việc tiêm Botox, nên 'them' ở đây thay thế cho 'injections'.

question: What is the word “twentysomething” in the last paragraph closest in meaning to?
explanation: 'twentysomething' chỉ những người trong độ tuổi 20-29, tức là dưới 30 tuổi.

question: Which advice does Dr Afshin Mosahebi most likely give to the 20s?
options: Botox injections should be prioritized to maintain youthful skin.
Starting Botox early provides the best defense against wrinkles.
Healthy habits and skincare routines are more important than Botox.
Rely on Botox for long-term results, but use more of it as you get older.
explanation: Bác sĩ khuyên người ở độ tuổi 20 nên tránh nắng, không hút thuốc, dùng kem chống nắng thay vì tiêm Botox.

question: Which of the following can be the best title of the passage?
explanation: Toàn bài tập trung nói về ảnh hưởng của việc sử dụng màn hình điện tử trước khi đi ngủ đến chất lượng giấc ngủ.

question: What is the word “severe” in paragraph 3 is closest in meaning to?
explanation: severe = serious: nghiêm trọng.

question: Which of the following is NOT TRUE according to the passage?
options: Sleeping well is very important to the development of the brain.
Reading printed books makes it difficult to fall asleep.
Exposure to blue light before bedtime does harm to sleep quality.
Poor sleep quality is likely to result in sadness and anxiety.
explanation: Bài viết khuyến khích đọc sách giấy trước khi ngủ vì giúp dễ ngủ hơn, nên đáp án B sai.

question: Which of the following can be inferred from the reading passage?
options: The effects of blue light on sleep are still controversial.
Tech companies have taken users' health into consideration.
An old-fashioned alarm clock is more popular than a new phone.
Chatting to others on social media should be avoided, especially for teenagers.
explanation: Các nhà sản xuất đã thêm chế độ ban đêm giảm ánh sáng xanh, cho thấy họ đã quan tâm đến sức khỏe người dùng.

question: Which of the following is probably the author’s advice for a better bedtime?
options: Use an old-fashioned alarm clock instead of relying on your phone to wake up.
Keep your phone close in case you wake up during the night.
Reduce the brightness on your phone’s screen if you must use it at night.
Keep your phone by your bedside to check notifications as soon as you wake up.
explanation: Tác giả khuyên 'You do not have to use the alarm on your phone. Go and buy yourself an old-fashioned alarm clock!'

question: Your friend just gave a presentation that you think was poorly prepared and delivered. Which of the following is the most constructive way to give feedback?
options: Your presentation was terrible. You should have practiced more.
I didn't really like your presentation. It was boring.
It can be better if you focus more on your delivery and use some visual aids.
You're not a good public speaker. But you shouldn't just think about giving up.
explanation: Phản hồi mang tính xây dựng cần nêu rõ điểm cần cải thiện một cách cụ thể, nhẹ nhàng và đưa ra hướng giải quyết thay vì chỉ trích.

question: During a team meeting, you have an idea that could improve the project. You are a bit introverted but you want to contribute to the project. What is the most appropriate way to raise your idea?
options: I think this idea could really improve our project. May I share it with everyone?
I have a suggestion. I’m not sure if it’s any good, but I’ll say it anyway.
I believe my idea could help, but I’m not sure if it’s what the team wants. What do you think?
I have an idea, but I’m not sure if it fits. Should I share it?
explanation: Cách nêu ý kiến tự tin, lịch sự, thể hiện sự tôn trọng và mong muốn đóng góp cho dự án.

question: Tim's commute never bothered him because there were always seats available on the train and he was able to spend his 40 minutes comfortably reading the newspaper or catching up on paperwork. Ever since the train schedule changed, the train has been extremely crowded, and by the time the doors open at his station, there isn't a seat to be found. Which statement is true according to the paragraph?
options: Tim would be better off taking the bus to work.
Tim's commute is less comfortable since the train schedule changed.
Many commuters will complain about the new train schedule.
Tim will likely look for a new job closer to home.
explanation: Thông tin trực tiếp: Trước đây có chỗ ngồi thoải mái, bây giờ rất đông không có chỗ ngồi → việc đi lại kém thoải mái hơn. Các đáp án khác không có thông tin hỗ trợ.

question: When you enter the Dead Sea, you notice that it's much easier to float compared to other bodies of water. What is the most likely explanation for this phenomenon?
options: The minerals in the Dead Sea water cause a chemical reaction that makes your body more buoyant.
The temperature of the water is warmer than usual, causing your body to become less dense and more buoyant.
The high salt concentration in the water increases its density, making it easier for objects and people to float.
The high levels of oxygen in the Dead Sea water reduce the effects of gravity, making it easier to float.
explanation: Nguyên lý vật lý: Nồng độ muối cao làm tăng khối lượng riêng của nước, lực đẩy nổi lớn hơn nên vật dễ nổi hơn.

question: Which of the following situations best exemplifies “sacrifice,” where someone gives up something valuable for the benefit of others?
options: Maria gives up her weekend plans to help her friend prepare for an important interview.
Maria lends her favorite book to a friend, knowing she can borrow it back later.
Maria decides to skip dessert to maintain her diet.
Maria works overtime to earn extra money for a vacation she’s planning.
explanation: Sự hy sinh là tự nguyện từ bỏ lợi ích/cái gì đó có giá trị của bản thân vì lợi ích của người khác. Chỉ có đáp án A phù hợp.
